This is the same reason the parity generator refuses the 7 dev / 6 prod web_search routes rather than emitting them. An absent probe here is a GAP, not a pass.

Same: metering on the bypass/hijack path cannot be measured where there is no bypass path. Note this is NOT the same as saying metering is complete -- P6 measured usage_reported_on_aborted_request = false, which is a real metering hole on a path that DOES exist.
